summary: Frontend-only test pass for AHU/VAV pill responsive scaling + iframe-mode modal embed + mobile mockup iframe wiring. All four scenarios exercised against the live preview URL. Code-level wiring is correct everywhere; one CSS scoping bug found in iframe-mode chrome hiding (#g36-timeline-strip and r5-toast-host leak because they are body-level siblings of #root, not children of it). Mobile mockup iframe embed works perfectly. Parity check across the three dashboard.html copies (public + V1.9 + V2.0) is byte-identical (matching MD5). Desktop pill scale multiplier code is in place at the documented lines but cannot be fully runtime-verified because this dev env has no equipment image assets — naturalWidth=0, so imgScale fallback to 1 (expected per spec).

ui_bugs.issue: Chrome leak: #g36-timeline-strip (dark G36 legend panel with mode/timeline/AHU OCCUPIED rows) AND .r5-toast-host remain VISIBLE in iframe-mode at small viewports. Root cause: these elements are body-direct siblings of #root (confirmed via DOM walk), but the hide rule only targets `body.iframe-modal-mode #root > * { visibility: hidden }`. Visible in screenshot of /dashboard.html?iframe=1&modal_ahu=AHU-01 at 360x640 — bottom ~40% of viewport shows the G36 timeline strip behind/below the modal. Spec explicitly lists 'G36 timeline' as chrome that must be hidden.

action_items: Extend iframe-mode hide rule in /app/frontend/public/dashboard.html (line ~146) to also hide body-direct chrome. Suggested patch: add `body.iframe-modal-mode > #g36-timeline-strip, body.iframe-modal-mode > .r5-toast-host { display: none !important; }` (or broaden to `body.iframe-modal-mode > div:not(#root) { display: none !important; }` and then keep the existing z-[120]/z-[130] allowlist for modal portal). Mirror the change into /app/archive/Red5-AHU-V1.9/dashboard.html and /app/archive/Red5-AHU-V2.0/dashboard.html to preserve parity.

Optional UX: when no equipment image is seeded (naturalWidth=0), pills currently render at scale(1) regardless of modal size. Consider falling back imgScale to (modal.contentWidth / DESIGN_BASE_WIDTH) when natW===0, so pills still shrink proportionally with the modal when the placeholder is shown. Low priority — placeholder mode is dev-only.
No action needed for mobile mockup or parity — both correct.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/public/dashboard.html line 146: `body.iframe-modal-mode #root > * { visibility: hidden !important; }` — selector scope is too narrow; chrome rendered outside #root (#g36-timeline-strip line confirmed, .r5-toast-host confirmed, and the standalone v2-auth-banner which luckily already has display:none) is not hidden. This is the only structural bug in the iframe-mode feature.

/app/frontend/public/dashboard.html line 5193 / 4320 / 4399: `scale(gScale * imgScale)` math is correct; imgScale = dispW/natW with `(dispW && natW) ? ... : 1` safe fallback when image fails to load. Looks robust.
/app/frontend/public/mobile_mockup.html line 249-252: iframe-fallback wiring is clean; src URL construction with encodeURIComponent is correct; loading='lazy' is appropriate.

Suggestion: in dashboard.html line 1882, the VAV auto-open `if (wantVav && ahuData && ahuData.length)` runs only after ahuData loads; if iframe loads before ahuData, the VAV setup is skipped because effect dep is [ahuData] — actually that re-fires, so OK. AHU path on line 1881 runs unconditionally (no ahuData gate). Both work.
dashboard.html is now 5653 lines — far over the 700-line guideline. Should be split into modules at the main agent's discretion (not a regression from this change).

rca of the issue.bug: G36 timeline panel (and toast host) visible inside iframe-mode dashboard
rca of the issue.reproduce: 1) Open https://controller-dashboard-2.preview.emergentagent.com/dashboard.html?iframe=1&modal_ahu=AHU-01 at 360x640 viewport. 2) Wait ~7s for React boot. 3) Observe: top 60% shows the AHU modal (correct), bottom ~40% shows a dark panel with G36 MODE TIMELINE 4H/24H legend and AHU-01..AHU-05 OCCUPIED rows (leaked chrome).
rca of the issue.rca: /app/frontend/public/dashboard.html line ~146 hides chrome via `body.iframe-modal-mode #root > * { visibility: hidden !important; }`. This selector only matches direct children of #root. DOM inspection confirms #g36-timeline-strip is appended as a body-direct child (likely outside the React tree, via a portal or direct DOM append), and .r5-toast-host similarly. Neither is reached by the existing selector, so both stay visible in iframe-mode.
rca of the issue.fix: Add `body.iframe-modal-mode > #g36-timeline-strip, body.iframe-modal-mode > .r5-toast-host { display: none !important; }` next to the existing #v2-auth-banner rule, OR generalise to `body.iframe-modal-mode > *:not(#root):not(script) { display: none !important; }` (cleaner). Then mirror to both V1.9 and V2.0 archive copies.
